name: Windows Event Log Service Configuration Tampered
description: Detects modification of the Windows Event Log service configuration or its log file paths. This is a strong indicator of an attempt to disable logging to cover tracks.

action.description: The configuration of the Windows Event Log or Event Collector service was modified or deleted, suggesting an attempt to impair logging.

operational_usage: This feature signals a direct attack on the system's audit capabilities. Any change to the 'Start' value or deletion of keys under this path by non-system processes is highly suspicious and indicative of anti-forensic activity.
false_positive: Rare. Major system updates or specific administrative tools might reconfigure these settings. Any other modification is a red flag.
